MORE:
This is to inform that pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., 10th August, 2026 considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results, along with ''Limited review Report'' of the Statutory Auditors thereon for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026. Enclosed herewith is a copy of the same.
The said meeting commenced at 02.30 p.m. and concluded at 03.35 p.m.
